# Fidelity Investments

> > Comprehensive financial services platform offering retirement planning, investment accounts (Roth IRA, HSA, 529 plans), brokerage services, ETF investing including iShares funds, and personalized financial advisory through nationwide investor centers.

Fidelity Investments provides a full spectrum of investment and financial planning services through Fidelity Brokerage Services LLC and Strategic Advisers LLC, both FMR LLC subsidiaries and SIPC members. The platform serves individual investors, families, and retirement savers with tools ranging from retirement calculators to direct indexing solutions and custodial accounts.

## Key Topics

- Retirement Planning & Calculators
- Roth IRA & Tax-Advantaged Accounts
- 529 College Savings Plans
- iShares ETFs & S&P 500 Investing
- Health Savings Accounts (HSA)
- Custodial Accounts (UGMA/UTMA)
- Fidelity Youth Accounts
- Direct Indexing & Basket Portfolios
- Financial Advisory Services
- Brokerage Services (SIPC Member)
- Strategic Advisers LLC
- Required Minimum Distributions (RMD)
- Income Generation Strategies
- Risk Management
- Investment Planning Tools

## Retirement Planning & Tools

- [Planning for Retirement | Retirement Calculators & Tools | Fidelity Investments](https://www.fidelity.com/calculators-tools/retirement-calculator/overview): Retirement calculators including RMD, income, and IRA planning tools

## Investment Products & ETFs

- [iShares ETFs | Create opportunities and lessen risk | Fidelity](https://www.fidelity.com/etfs/ishares): iShares ETF offerings including S&P 500 (IVV) for income and risk management
- [Fidelity Basket Portfolios | FAQs | Fidelity Investments](https://www.fidelity.com/direct-indexing/customized-investing/faqs): FAQ for Fidelity Basket Portfolios with stocks and ETFs in one trade

## Education & Family Savings

- [Arizona 529 Plan Investment Options | Fidelity](https://www.fidelity.com/529-plans/arizona-investment-options): Arizona UNIQUE College Investing Plan 529 investment options
- [Saving & Investing for a Child | custodial, IRA, youth, 529 & ABLE accounts | Fidelity](https://www.fidelity.com/building-savings/child-saving-and-investing): Child savings options: 529, UGMA/UTMA custodial, Fidelity Youth, and ABLE
